summary: Candidate is a distinct D3 scale configuration skill (ordinal scale) with different semantic capability from existing Flink stream processing skills. Peer candidates (Threshold, Quantile, Link Generator) are all D3 visualization layer skills in same task_family but represent different scale types; ordinal scale is semantifically distinct from threshold and quantile scales. No existing skill covers ordinal scale configuration. Asset type, granularity, and domain all align with peer candidates but not with existing Flink-focused skills.
